New This Release
Alliance Merge Update
Alliance Leaders now have more control over how their Alliance grows.

A new Public (No Merge) option allows anyone to join your Alliance while preventing other Alliances from merging into it.

Alliance Leaders can now choose from three settings:

Public – Players can join, and other Alliances can merge into your Alliance.
Public (No Merge) – Players can join, but other Alliances cannot merge into your Alliance.
Private – Your Alliance remains closed to pub
